title: Two Sum
summary: Find the two positions in an unsorted array whose values add up to a target, in one pass.

tests.explain: nums[2] + nums[3] = 1 + 6 = 7. Returning [3, 2] is accepted too.
1 + 5 = 6. Using the 3 at index 0 twice would also make 6, but a position can't be used twice.
Two different positions may hold the same value.

hints: The brute force checks every pair in O(n²). For one number x, which single value would complete the pair?
You need target - x. Can you remember the numbers you have already passed so that checking for it costs O(1)?
Keep a Map from value to index. For each nums[i], look up target - nums[i] before storing nums[i], so an element never pairs with itself.

complexity.time: O(n): one pass with O(1) average map operations
complexity.space: O(n): the map can hold every value
